about.heading: Hi Brands!
bullets: I create warm, natural and visually polished content that feels authentic, relatable and made to stop the scroll — without looking overly staged or “too ad-like.”

I’m an Austria-based lifestyle & UGC creator sharing beauty, fashion, wellness and everyday life. Alongside content creation, I’m also a medical student, which naturally shapes my content around routines, balance, self-care and real everyday moments.
My visual style is feminine, clean and lifestyle-driven, with warm neutrals, soft natural light, simple details, cozy settings and an elevated but still approachable feel.

I help brands present their products naturally through aesthetic b-roll, product demos, tutorials, voiceovers, lifestyle integrations, clean product shots and content that fits seamlessly into everyday life.
